primary_source.title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models: Non-linearity, Sparsity, and Attention-Sink-Free
primary_source.scope_limit: LLM evidence motivates placement only; it is not evidence for this forecasting task.

mechanism.placement: After exact-window SDPA and before the existing attention output projection
mechanism.headwise_formula: sigmoid(linear(norm_attention(x))) with zero-initialized weight and bias
mechanism.muon_routing: Existing QKV and hidden Muon groups unchanged; head_gate.weight uses AdamW matrix decay and head_gate.bias uses AdamW no-decay.

runtime.profile_identity: Exact production config, source, split, data, precision, device and world size

evaluation.checkpoint_selection: none; held-out metrics are not consumed before final checkpoint
evaluation.exposure: F0 and F2 are previously exposed folds
evaluation.mechanistic_control: constant_half minus none; headwise minus constant_half

conditional_scale_followup.training_recipe: Same explicit recipe and precision as initial teachers; lr=3e-4 is an un-tuned starting point.
conditional_scale_followup.parameter_count_note: Approximately 1.54B by architecture arithmetic; not measured.

conditional_student_followup.teacher_cache: Fitting-membership output predictions; same exact cache path for profile and fit; one/eight-rank parity required.
conditional_student_followup.objective: KD weight 1, no hidden hints; no labels-only student control.

decision_rule.exploratory_trigger: +0.0005 mean WP with both paired fold deltas nonnegative
decision_rule.uncertainty_limit: Two exposed fold/seed pairs confound fold and seed and do not estimate training variance.
